definition: Additional compensation tied to years of service.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 40 distinct documented longevity implementation events across 35 municipalities in 13 states. Additional compensation tied to years of service. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
